answer_1.quote: We use Llama-2-13B-chat and Llama-3-8B model for the text generation and stable-diffusion-v1.5 model for text-to-image generation tasks.

answer_2.quote: We adopt the Area Under the ROC Curve (AUC) as the evaluation metric, which measures the probability that a randomly selected mislabeled sample receives a higher influence score than a clean sample.
